title.en: Equation of a line in space

hook.en: A laser pointer fixes a straight beam with just two things: where it starts and which way it points. A line in space is described the same way.
hook.kn: ಲೇಸರ್ ಪಾಯಿಂಟರ್ ಎರಡೇ ವಿಷಯಗಳಿಂದ ನೇರ ಕಿರಣವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ಎಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಆರಂಭ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ. ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿನ ಸರಳರೇಖೆಯನ್ನೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

objectives.en: Write the vector equation r⃗ = a⃗ + λb⃗
Write the Cartesian equation of a line
Find the line through two points and convert between forms

narration.en: A laser pointer fixes a straight beam with just two things: where it starts and which way it points. A line in space is described the same way.
narration.kn: ಲೇಸರ್ ಪಾಯಿಂಟರ್ ಎರಡೇ ವಿಷಯಗಳಿಂದ ನೇರ ಕಿರಣವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ಎಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಆರಂಭ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ. ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿನ ಸರಳರೇಖೆಯನ್ನೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

body.en: The line through the point with position vector $\vec a$ and parallel to $\vec b$ is $\vec r = \vec a + \lambda\vec b$, where $\lambda$ is a real parameter. Each value of $\lambda$ gives one point of the line. Through two points $\vec a$ and $\vec b$: $\vec r = \vec a + \lambda(\vec b - \vec a)$.
body.kn: a ಸ್ಥಾನ ಸದಿಶದ ಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಮೂಲಕ b ಗೆ ಸಮಾಂತರ ರೇಖೆ: r = a + λb. λ ಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬೆಲೆಯೂ ರೇಖೆಯ ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದು. ಎರಡು ಬಿಂದುಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ: r = a + λ(b − a).

points.en: a⃗: a point on the line; b⃗: a direction of the line
Through two points, b⃗ is replaced by their difference

narration.en: Start at the point a and move any multiple lambda of the direction b. That gives r equals a plus lambda b. Each value of lambda is one point on the line.
narration.kn: a ಸ್ಥಾನ ಸದಿಶದ ಬಿಂದುವಿನ ಮೂಲಕ b ಗೆ ಸಮಾಂತರ ರೇಖೆ: r = a + λb. λ ಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬೆಲೆಯೂ ರೇಖೆಯ ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದು. ಎರಡು ಬಿಂದುಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ: r = a + λ(b − a).

title.en: A line from a point and a direction

narration.en: The teacher draws a line through a point parallel to a vector, marks values of lambda and writes both forms.

say.en: A line is fixed by one point A on it and a direction b. Every point P on the line is A plus some multiple of b.
Mark lambda: lambda is 0 at A, 1 one step along b, and negative values go backwards.
So the vector equation is r = a plus lambda b.
Compare components to get the Cartesian form. Each fraction equals lambda.
Example: through 5, 2, minus 4, parallel to 3 i plus 2 j minus 8 k.

draw.tex: \vec r=(5\hat i+2\hat j-4\hat k)+\lambda(3\hat i+2\hat j-8\hat k)

say.en: In Cartesian form: x minus 5 over 3 equals y minus 2 over 2 equals z plus 4 over minus 8.

narration.en: The line passes through A(2, −1, 1) parallel to b. Each λ gives one point P with position vector a + λb. Move λ and read the coordinates; they satisfy the Cartesian form (x − 2)/b₁ = (y + 1)/b₂ = (z − 1)/b₃ = λ.
narration.kn: ರೇಖೆ A(2, −1, 1) ಮೂಲಕ b ಗೆ ಸಮಾಂತರ. ಪ್ರತಿ λ ಗೆ ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದು P, ಸ್ಥಾನ ಸದಿಶ a + λb. λ ಸರಿಸಿ ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ; ಅವು (x − 2)/b₁ = (y + 1)/b₂ = (z − 1)/b₃ = λ ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: The line passes through A(2, −1, 1) parallel to b. Each λ gives one point P with position vector a + λb. Move λ and read the coordinates; they satisfy the Cartesian form (x − 2)/b₁ = (y + 1)/b₂ = (z − 1)/b₃ = λ.
caption.kn: ರೇಖೆ A(2, −1, 1) ಮೂಲಕ b ಗೆ ಸಮಾಂತರ. ಪ್ರತಿ λ ಗೆ ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದು P, ಸ್ಥಾನ ಸದಿಶ a + λb. λ ಸರಿಸಿ ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ; ಅವು (x − 2)/b₁ = (y + 1)/b₂ = (z − 1)/b₃ = λ ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

tryThis.en: With b = (1, 2, 2) and λ = 1, check P = (3, 1, 3).
For b = (0, 1, −1), why must x stay 2 all along the line?

body.en: If the line passes through $(x_1, y_1, z_1)$ and has direction ratios $a, b, c$, then $\frac{x - x_1}{a} = \frac{y - y_1}{b} = \frac{z - z_1}{c}$. Through two points the denominators are $x_2 - x_1$, $y_2 - y_1$, $z_2 - z_1$.
body.kn: (x₁, y₁, z₁) ಮೂಲಕ, a, b, c ದಿಕ್ ಅನುಪಾತಗಳ ರೇಖೆ: (x − x₁)/a = (y − y₁)/b = (z − z₁)/c.

points.en: Numerators give the point (with signs changed)

narration.en: In Cartesian form, subtract the point's coordinates in the numerators and put the direction ratios in the denominators, all three equal.
narration.kn: (x₁, y₁, z₁) ಮೂಲಕ, a, b, c ದಿಕ್ ಅನುಪಾತಗಳ ರೇಖೆ: (x − x₁)/a = (y − y₁)/b = (z − z₁)/c.

caption.en: The line r = (5î + 2ĵ − 4k̂) + λ(3î + 2ĵ − 8k̂). Move λ to walk along the line and read the coordinates of the point.

narration.en: Move lambda to walk along the line. Every value of lambda gives one point on it.

tryThis.en: Find λ where the line meets the xy-plane (z = 0).
Check that λ = 1 is √77 units from A.

problem.en: Find the vector and Cartesian equations of the line through (5, 2, −4) parallel to 3î + 2ĵ − 8k̂.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the vector and Cartesian equations of the line through (5, 2, −4) parallel to 3î + 2ĵ − 8k̂.

problem.en: Write the vector form of the line (x − 5)/3 = (y + 4)/7 = (z − 6)/2.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Write the vector form of the line (x − 5)/3 = (y + 4)/7 = (z − 6)/2.

body.en: Before reading a point or direction ratios, make the coefficient of x, y and z equal to +1. (1 − x)/2 becomes (x − 1)/(−2); (2y − 3)/4 becomes (y − 3/2)/2. Many exam options are built on skipping this step.

narration.en: Coefficient one first. Before reading a point or direction ratios, make the coefficient of x, y and z equal to +1. (1 − x)/2 becomes (x − 1)/(−2); (2y − 3)/4 becomes (y − 3/2)/2. Many exam options are built on skipping this step.

mnemonic.en: Plus-one x, y, z, then read

narration.en: Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the pattern of KCET, COMEDK and JEE. Read every option before you choose.

points.kn: ಸದಿಶ ರೂಪ: r = a + λb (ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದು ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ದಿಕ್ಕು).

points.en: Make the coefficients of x, y, z equal to +1 before reading off values.
points.kn: ಬೆಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಓದುವ ಮುನ್ನ x, y, z ಗುಣಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು +1 ಮಾಡಿ.

narration.en: Recap. Vector form: r⃗ = a⃗ + λb⃗ (a point plus a direction). Cartesian form: (x − x₁)/a = (y − y₁)/b = (z − z₁)/c. Make the coefficients of x, y, z equal to +1 before reading off values.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸದಿಶ ರೂಪ: r = a + λb (ಒಂದು ಬಿಂದು ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ದಿಕ್ಕು). ಕಾರ್ಟೀಸಿಯನ್ ರೂಪ: (x − x₁)/a = (y − y₁)/b = (z − z₁)/c. ಬೆಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಓದುವ ಮುನ್ನ x, y, z ಗುಣಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು +1 ಮಾಡಿ.
